Fiscal Q1 2027 (to 30 Sep 2026) revenue 479M USD, up 69%, a record; FY2027 outlook raised to 2.45bn to 2.65bn USD revenue; backlog fully covers FY2027 guidance (release, 12 Nov 2026). NYSE IPO in Feb 2026 raised about 1.5bn USD at 27 USD a share. CFO transition announced 26 Oct 2026. CEO Gary Niederpruem.
Ownership: private equity firm Neos Partners kept majority voting control after the IPO (IPO coverage via search, not opened). Check decision-making route.

End markets at IPO: data centres 42%, grid 23%, industrial 19%, other 16% (Renaissance Capital). Utilities and power producers are a core sector but have no honest grid example, so they are left out of the target sentence. Grid names are sector examples, not confirmed customers.
Brands: MGM Transformer, VanTran, PwrQ and States Mfg (forgentpower.com).

Grid availability: Schneider Electric (McLaren) and Siemens (Red Bull and Racing Bulls, industrial technology) both sell switchgear and power distribution. Alternative reference: Siemens (details not checked).
Collision: Modine Manufacturing (data centre cooling) is in this batch and uses the same Schneider Electric reference. Sequence sends or vary one.
Calendar: US-focused with a Mexico plant; no international expansion found. No sanctions or Entity List issue.
